snippet.title: Jumanji: The Video Game - PlayStation 5 Enhanced Edition Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP3824-PPSA03978_00-2517119461623984/

Return to the jungle on PS5! Experience the beautiful and dangerous world of #JumanjiTheVideoGame with all-new enhanced features exclusive to the PlayStation 5: 

➡️ Up to 120 FPS 
➡️ 4K Dynamic Resolution 
➡️ HDR 
➡️ Faster Loading Times 
➡️ Free upgrade for existing PS4 owners
